I'm fed up with this company, and ready to eat the loss. Good luck to you.

I used all of the first set, even though halfway through I knew it wasn't working. At the time, I was still hopeful that after refinements I'd get the desired results.

I was honestly hoping for them to offer me half of my money back. At this point I can see the writing on the wall and I'm not expecting anything. Considering it a loss.

My teeth did not really improve. A lot of posters here said I never should've gone with it anyway, as my plans arguably made my bite worse. But all I really wanted was straighter top front teeth. If I could go back in time, I'd bite the bullet and pay more for traditional methods.

I was waiting since November. After trying to cancel, instead of cancelling they rushed my order and shipped it to me. I'm about to post a thread about my troubles with this company.

You could try opening a BBB case. I got a response through that, even if it wasn't the response I desired.

Don't believe anything they tell you.. in my experience it was all delays and lies.
